situation: Half the class did the reading and half clearly did not, and the half that did is getting visibly annoyed at carrying discussions.

dims.SPEAKABILITY: Card 2's lines are more natural and concrete ("came in loaded and ready," "run on half the fuel"), while Card 1's Collaboration beat runs long and philosophical in a way that would sound rehearsed aloud.
dims.SPECIFICITY: Card 2 diagnoses the exact mechanism — that avoidance pays off precisely when the gap is visible and the readers' visible frustration blocks re-entry without losing face — whereas Card 1 stays a notch more abstract about resentment and status.
dims.TIGHTNESS: Card 2 gives a concrete, executable pair-talk with assigned roles rather than an open-ended "what would help?" ask, and wastes fewer words on framing.
dims.HONESTY: Both hold the standard, but Card 2 keeps the discomfort in view ("both groups know which they are," a cost "you can feel in the room") while still delivering an actual foothold, rather than resolving into the warmer group-belonging language Card 1 leans on.
